title: Global Financial Crisis: Lehman to the Bottom (2008–09)
description: From the last close before Lehman Brothers' bankruptcy to the S&P 500's crisis low. Credit markets froze, banks and real estate collapsed, and long Treasuries and gold rallied. Shocks are real total returns (Yahoo Finance adjusted close) from 2008-09-12 to 2009-03-09.
source_name: Yahoo Finance (adjusted close); events cited in references
transmission: 2008-09-15: Lehman Brothers files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection [1]
2008-12-16: Fed cuts the federal funds target range to 0–0.25% [2]
2009-03-09: S&P 500 closes at its crisis low (window end)
